skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to manage network systems including configuration and administration.
Understanding and application of Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP).
Configuring routers using simulation software such as Packet Tracer.
Managing Windows Server including group policy configuration and resource management.
Implementing network security measures with firewalls and other security tools.
Ability to independently research and understand network-related technologies.
Working in groups to solve practical network management problems.
